kind.help_task_block: Time you set aside to work on one task.
kind.help_preference: A soft window, e.g. study hours. Never counts as busy; suggestions prefer it.

suggest.title: Find time for “{{title}}”
suggest.none: No free slot in your working hours before it's due. Consider moving the deadline or freeing up time.
suggest.partial: Covers part of the remaining time
suggest.confirmBody: Block {{when}} for “{{title}}”? Nothing else on your calendar changes.

workingHours.title: Working hours
workingHours.help: Used to find free time and suggest slots. Outside these hours nothing is suggested.

agenda.emptyBody: A free day. Plan it, or add an event.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.intro: Link Life OS with Google Calendar both ways, without signing in to Google. Each side stays read-only in the other, and updates every few hours.
google.outTitle: See Life OS in Google Calendar
google.outBody: Your events and task due dates, on a private address Google Calendar can subscribe to.
google.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it yourself.
google.outStep1: Open Google Calendar on a computer.
google.outStep2: Next to "Other calendars", press + and choose "From URL".
google.outStep3: Paste this address and press "Add calendar". Google refreshes it every few hours.
google.outPrivate: Keep this address private: anyone who has it can see your calendar. If it gets out, make a new one.
google.feedReset: New address made. The old one no longer works.
google.inTitle: See Google Calendar in Life OS
google.inBody: Your Google events show on the Life OS calendar, and Plan my day treats them as busy time.
google.inStep1: In Google Calendar, open Settings, then pick your calendar under "Settings for my calendars".
google.inStep2: Scroll to "Secret address in iCal format" (not the public address) and copy it. It contains "private-".
google.linked: Google Calendar linked. Its events now show on your calendar.
google.linkedError: Linked, but Google's calendar couldn't be read just now. Check the address.
google.inOk: Linked: your Google events show on the calendar.
google.inError: Linked, but Google's calendar couldn't be read just now. It will try again soon.

problem.public_not_shared: This is your calendar's public address, but the calendar isn't public, so Google won't share it. Unlink, then copy "Secret address in iCal format" instead (it contains "private-").
problem.not_found: Google doesn't recognise this address. It may be cut short, or the secret address was reset in Google. Unlink and copy it again.
problem.denied: Google refused to share this calendar. Unlink and copy "Secret address in iCal format" again.
problem.google_busy: Google is having trouble right now. Life OS will try again in a few minutes.
problem.timeout: Google took too long to answer. Life OS will try again in a few minutes.
problem.unreachable: Google couldn't be reached. Life OS will try again in a few minutes.
problem.too_large: This calendar is too big to read (over 5 MB).
problem.not_calendar: Google answered, but not with a calendar. Check that you copied the iCal address, not the page address.
